_comment: Items (DT_Enemies: the game's code calls items 'enemies'). Prices are gold/silver/copper as X/Y/Z.

Limestone._comment: Each Limestone holds 300 units for the Stone Crusher (was 150). A negative MaximumStack is the units in one item; a positive one is the stack size.

HealingPotion._comment: Healing Potions sell for 120 copper in your shop (was 85)

Stone._comment: The Stone Crusher's recipe for Limestone. Its FractionNum is probably what the tooltip shows as the Stone per Limestone, so it changes with MaximumStack (was 150)

FlaxSeed._comment: Flax needs 12 V of fertilizer to grow (was 24)
